description.en: The market, toasted buns and the nearby carinderia alley.

narration.en: The People’s Mall grew from construction begun in 1964 into an operating market in 1969. Its Siopao Center is a stop for toasted buns.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap
sources.note: Location and name only; no construction date inferred.

sources.title: City of Naga: Public market history (2021)
City of Naga: The Siopao Center (2022)

narration.en: 3N’s toasted siopao is baked rather than steamed. GMC credits the Sta. Maria family with scaling production in the 1990s. This marker represents the market area; the exact stall is unconfirmed.

sources.title: City of Naga: The Siopao Center (2022)
OpenStreetMap: People’s Mall placement area
sources.note: Representative Point inside the mapped market, supported by the city’s inside-the-mall address. Exact stall/entrance position is unknown; the Point does not replace the market footprint.

narration.en: By San Francisco Church, Face the Wall is an alley of carinderias serving silog, laing and kinunot: Bicolano cooking rather than dishes claimed as Naga inventions.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap: San Francisco Church area
sources.note: Overview camera for the nearby alley; no stall or alley footprint is asserted.
